ResearchProjectDef.label: automated ammunition press kludging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how to patch a wrecked automated ammunition press back into crude service. Needs a wrecked automated ammunition press that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the kludge on the wrecked automated ammunition press where it stands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: automated ammunition press refurbishment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to bring a kludged automated ammunition press close to what it was. This is not the original engineering, which its makers already solved. It is the colony's own hard-won knowledge of how to bring a dead one back. Needs a kludged automated ammunition press that a researcher has studied.\n\nOnce this is done, order the refurbishment on the kludged automated ammunition press where it stands. It needs an ancient component.
